sources.sitDownSeconds: A person's weight comes onto a vessel as they sit down in her: stand-to-sit takes 1.55 ± 0.33 s in young healthy adults (Wairagkar et al. 2021, A novel approach for modelling and classifying sit-to-stand kinematics using inertial sensors, arXiv:2107.06859)
sources.standUpSeconds: And leaves her as they stand up: sit-to-stand takes 1.44 ± 0.36 s in the same study
